name: Vina San Pedro Tarapaca S.A.
summary: Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A. produces and exports wines in Chile and internationally. It markets its products under the Cabo de Hornos, Kankana del Elqui, Tierras Moradas, Sideral, Altair, 1865 Single Vineyard, 1865 Master Blend, 1865 Old Vines, 1865 Pisco Barrel, 1865 Desert Valley, 1865 Tayu, Castillo de Molina, Castillo de Molina Tributo, 9 Lives, Epica, and GatoNegro brand names. The company was founded in 1865 and is based in Santiago, Chile. Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A. is a subsidiary of CCU Inversiones S.A.
